# Klyv — every component

614 components, published as `klyvui`. A `*` marks a required
prop. Import any of them from 'klyvui'. Full docs: https://klyvui.xyz

## A11yInspector
Its own checks on the live page — missing names and alt text, heading jumps, tabindex, contrast, duplicate ids — numbered on the elements concerned.
  group: SaaS / Settings & developer
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/a11y-inspector
  copy: npx klyvui add a11y-inspector
  - target*: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>
  - rules: A11yInspectorRule[]
  - autoRun: boolean
  - defaultShowBadges: boolean
  - onAudit: (issues: A11yInspectorIssue[]) => void
  - className: string

## AccessDeniedState
A 403 body that names what you tried to open, who owns it and which account you are using, with a request access button that becomes a sent state.
  group: Feedback / Empty & error
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/access-denied-state
  copy: npx klyvui add access-denied-state
  - resource*: string
  - resourceType: string
  - title: string
  - description: ReactNode
  - owner: AccessDeniedStateOwner
  - onRequestAccess: () => void | Promise<void>
  - requestStatus: AccessDeniedStateRequestStatus
  - account: string
  - switchAccountHref: string
  - onSwitchAccount: () => void
  - headingLevel: AccessDeniedStateHeadingLevel
  - className: string

## AccessExplainer
Answers whether a user can act on a resource by showing each step: groups, inheritance, every rule checked and which deny beat which allow.
  group: SaaS / Security
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/access-explainer
  copy: npx klyvui add access-explainer
  - policy*: AccessExplainerPolicy
  - query: AccessExplainerQuery
  - defaultQuery: AccessExplainerQuery
  - onQueryChange: (query: AccessExplainerQuery) => void
  - actions: string[]
  - className: string

## AccessRequests
Pending join requests with the requester’s note. Change the role before approving, deny with a reason, or select several at once.
  group: SaaS / Workspace
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/access-requests
  copy: npx klyvui add access-requests
  - requests*: AccessRequestsItem[]
  - roles*: AccessRequestsRole[]
  - onApprove*: (approvals: AccessRequestsApproval[]) => void | Promise<void>
  - onDeny*: (ids: string[], reason: string) => void | Promise<void>
  - resourceName: string
  - className: string

  - fileName: string
  - showSummary: boolean
  - placement: PopoverPlacement
  - align: PopoverAlign
  - onSelect: (provider: AddToCalendarProvider) => void
  - className: string

## AddressInput

  - required: boolean
  - disabled: boolean
  - hideLabel: boolean
  - className: string

## AnimatedList
Rows animate in when added and fold away when removed, matched by key. Focus moves off a leaving row, and nothing animates under reduced motion.

  - className: string

  group: Overlays / Popovers
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/picture-in-picture
  copy: npx klyvui add picture-in-picture
  - children*: ReactNode
  - width: number
  - height: number
  - openLabel: string
  - closeLabel: string
  - placeholder: ReactNode
  - unsupportedMessage: ReactNode
  - onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void
  - className: string

## PinPad
A keypad and the physical keyboard as one control, where rejection is the return value rather than a ref reaching in.

  - errorMessage: string
  - extra: { label: string; onSelect: () => void; glyph?: string }
  - disabled: boolean
  - className: string

## PitchTuner
A chromatic tuner that listens through the microphone and shows the note, octave and cents off on a needle, with adjustable A4.
  group: Canvas & Play / Audio
  docs: https://klyvui.xyz/components/pitch-tuner
  copy: npx klyvui add pitch-tuner
  - referenceA4: number
  - defaultReferenceA4: number
  - onReferenceA4Change: (hertz: number) => void
  - tolerance: number
  - minFrequency: number
  - maxFrequency: number
  - onPitch: (reading: PitchTunerReading | null) => void
  - label: string
  - className: string

  - aspectRatio: number
  - controls: boolean
  - label: string
